SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_women
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN disp AS p ON p.account_id = a.account_id AND p.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = p.client_id
WHERE CAST(d.A11 AS REAL) > 10000
